notes: Replaced three bare hasattr() existence checks with structural oracle assertions: (1) DiscoveryEvent verified as a real dataclass type with provider and model_count fields; (2) DtypeOption verified as typing.Literal with exactly the six expected dtype strings via get_origin/get_args comparison against an independent frozen reference set; (3) ModelConfig verified as a real dataclass type with model_id and dtype fields.
